name: MACU (Mongolian Artisan Cheesemakers Union) LLC
attributes: Overseas exhibitors | Exportable | Co-exhibitor | Organizer : MONGOLIA
intro: At our booth, you can taste Khustai Gouda, our artisanal, high-quality Mongolian cheese. At MACU, we preserve traditional cheesemaking methods while embracing Mongolia's local terroir. We source milk from nomadic pastoralists, capturing the unique flavors of the region. MACU is also committed to sustainability, supporting local herders and promoting Mongolian dairy products both locally and internationally. Our cheeses, made without artificial preservatives, highlight the distinct taste of Mongolian milk, often from under-utilized pastoral resources. The aging process enhances the strong flavors, making our cheese an excellent pairing with wine. MACU aims to develop small-scale cheese plants in rural areas, in collaboration with local governments and communities. This initiative helps unlock the potential of Mongolia's pastoral milk, creating high-quality cheeses from animals grazing on wild forbs in Mongolia’s vast pastures. The project also provides additional income streams for rural communities, reducing their reliance on cashmere and helping to prevent overgrazing of Mongolian grasslands.
exhibited_products: We produce and sell Mongolian artisanal cheeses. For Foodex, we will present our flagship product, Khustai Gouda, the oldest and premier Mongolian cheese, made continuously for 30 years in the Khustai National Park. Produced by Tumurkhuyag Urtnasan and his family since 1995, it comes from a remote, nomadic area 80 km southwest of Ulaanbaatar. Khustai Gouda is unique for several reasons. The milk used comes from cows grazing on wild forbs in high-altitude pastures. This summer milk is rich in proteins and minerals, giving the cheese its distinctive flavor. Handmade in small batches, the cheese is salted and aged for 2-3 months in a wooden shed before further maturation near Ulaanbaatar. Some batches age up to 18 months, resulting in a firm, crumbly texture and a flavor that evolves from mild and slightly salty to rich, nutty, and caramelized with umami notes. Unlike industrial Gouda, it contains no preservatives or additives, reflecting the pure taste of Mongolian milk. Khustai Gouda stands out for its exceptional quality and pairs well with wine, enhancing dishes like fondue and pasta.

intro: Red Gold from Europe is a promotional and informative campaign co-funded by the European Commission and managed by ANICAV – the Italian Association of Canned Vegetables Industries – to promote the consumption and export of European and Italian canned tomatoes. ANICAV members account for over 60% of all the processed tomatoes in Italy, and nearly all of the whole peeled tomatoes produced in the world (including the well-known San Marzano DOP). Preserved tomatoes were first prepared centuries ago. Over time, the traditional production techniques have evolved, using science and technology to guarantee today even greater safely and quality. Traditional method has remained broadly the same, apart from some phases where new technologies have increased the safety of the product and made production processes more efficient. Canned tomatoes, available all year long, can even be better than the fresh product when out of season. This is because the processing method makes useful nutrients, such as lycopene, a powerful antioxidant, more easily absorbed by the body. Few other foods are as healthy and wholesome as tomatoes, so just let yourself be conquered by their unique taste.
